title: Quasi-War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Quasi-War", at revision 1373055161, opens: "The Quasi-War, 1798 to 1800, was an undeclared war between the United States and the French First Republic. It was fought almost entirely at sea, primarily in the Caribbean and off the East Coast of the United States, with minor actions in the Indian Ocean and Mediterranean Sea." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q655480, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1798-1800 naval war during the French Revolutionary Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
